title: Platform overview
seoTitle: Platform Overview |  DataChannel | Reliable Automated ELT & Reverse ETL Platform
seoDescription: DataChannel is a cloud based data integration and reverse ETL platform to automate the data collection, preparation and management process of all your marketing, CRM, financial & operational data.

blocks.title: Single platform for all your ETL & Reverse ETL requirements.
blocks.subtitle: Integrate data from multiple data sources to any data warehouse. Activate your data and empower your business teams.

blocks.heading: Empower your business with seamless data integration

items.title: Unified ELT & Reverse ETL platform
items.body: Only platform designed to handle both forward and reverse data flow pipelines without coding or scripts

items.title: Choose where your data resides
items.body: All popular cloud data warehouses supported. Connect your own data warehouse or choose a DataChannel managed warehouse.

items.title: Truly cost effective solution
items.body: Our transparent usage based pricing ensures you get maximum value for your investment without paying for multiple tools.

blocks.heading: Only ETL & Reverse ETL solution you will ever need

items.title: Complete control over your data
items.body: Our data connectors offer granular control over what fields you wish to sync. Avoid bringing in restricted / PII data.

items.title: 100+ battle-tested integrations
items.body: Gather all your data from any platform you are using - marketing, sales, financial, eCommerce or real time events.

items.title: Automatic updates
items.body: Our integrations are thoroughly tested and reliable - so you never need to worry about API updates or quota limits.

items.title: Accelerate time to insights
items.body: Prepare data for analytics seamlessly as it lands in the warehouse through powerful data models and workflows that run in sync with your pipelines.

items.title: Designed to scale with your business
items.body: Scale to billions of rows of data without worrying about maintaining elaborate infrastructure and rising server costs.

items.title: Flexible & Advanced Scheduling
items.body: Orchestrate your data flow with our advanced scheduling options and dependency checks. Refresh pipelines at as low as 15 minute intervals.

items.title: Security
items.body: DataChannel leverages OAuth2 to connect securely to your data sources, so you never have to worry about sharing credentials. Store data in your own cloud infrastructure by connecting your data warehouse.

items.title: Intuitive & simple self-serve interface
items.body: Our transparent usage based pricing ensures you get maximum value for your investment without paying for multiple tools.

blocks.heading: Start leveraging your data in four easy steps

items.title: Choose your data destination
items.body: Reliably centralize data into the destination of your choice

items.title: Connect your data source
items.body: Securely connect to all the databases and apps that drive your business

items.title: Configure & schedule your pipelines
items.body: Select what data to sync and when with our advanced scheduling options and granular pipeline configuration

items.title: Start consuming your data
items.body: Never worry about the pipelines again and focus on drawing critical business insights using tools of your choice
